title: Pan-Seared Norwegian Salmon with Biryani Rice
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish featuring pan-seared salmon served with fragrant biryani rice. This recipe is perfect for a lunch or dinner option.

ingredients.name: Biryani rice
ingredients.notes: Basmati or long-grain rice works well

ingredients.name: Birista (fried onions)
ingredients.notes: Optional, but adds a nice crunch

instructions: 1. Rinse the salmon fillets under cold water, pat dry with a paper towel, and season with salt and pepper.
2. Heat the kissed olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add the silky onion to the skillet and cook until caramelized, about 5 minutes.
4. Add the birista to the skillet and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
5. Add the salmon fillets to the skillet, skin side up (if they have skin).
6. Cook the salmon for 3-4 minutes, then flip and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes, or until cooked through.
7. Meanwhile, prepare the biryani rice according to package instructions.
8. To serve, place a salmon fillet on top of a bed of biryani rice, spoon some of the onion and birista mixture over the top.
9. Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
